method_definitions.crop_mean: Arithmetic mean yield_kg_ha for crop in training fold, ignoring district and season.
method_definitions.crop_season_mean: Arithmetic mean yield_kg_ha for crop and season_code in training fold.
method_definitions.district_crop_season_weighted: Sum(production_mt * 1000) / sum(harvested_area_ha) for district/crop/season_code in training fold; missing value falls back to training-fold crop mean.
method_definitions.previous_season_same_district_crop: Previous chronological season for same district/crop from training fold only; unavailable values remain missing.
method_definitions.rank_metrics: Spearman and top-6 overlap are computed within fold/crop/season groups; top-six denominator is min(6, observed district count). Leave-one-district-out rankings are unavailable because each held-out fold contains only one district.
method_definitions.within_crop_metrics: Compute metrics per crop and macro-average; centered R-squared subtracts the held-out crop's actual mean from actual and predicted values.

notes: Per-fold district ranking metrics are not estimable: each fold holds out one district.
